title: Pixel, catalog and binary-orbit follow-up for four leads
kind: same-epoch pixel re-reduction and exact-source catalog follow-up
summary: A separate cached-TPF reduction confirms displaced TOI-224 E4, TOI-3500 E2 and TOI-7610 E1 localizations. Exact Gaia/SIMBAD rows establish TOI-7610 as an SB1 with a stellar-mass companion, so that exoplanet lead is retired. A TOI-3500 Gaussian-PRF sensitivity grid usually favors the target but cannot separate the 0.184-pixel pair robustly. Three active Unverified leads remain; none is promoted.

checks.name: Cached TPF input integrity
checks.note: 12 TPFs checked by filename, byte count and SHA-256; hashes are in SEARCH_LOG.md.

checks.name: Independent same-epoch aperture reduction
checks.note: Four aperture definitions and 300 bootstrap resamples per event completed for 12 event/control windows.

checks.name: TOI-224 E4 localization
checks.note: S106 local-peak offset 8.70 arcsec at 8.60 bootstrap sigma; independent reduction reproduces the displaced source.

checks.name: TOI-2666 E1 localization
checks.note: S99 local-peak offset 0.37 arcsec at 0.74 bootstrap sigma; same-epoch source localization survives this reduction.

checks.name: TOI-3500 E1 localization
checks.note: S90 local-peak offset 0.35 arcsec at 0.65 bootstrap sigma.

checks.name: TOI-3500 E2 localization
checks.note: S101 local-peak offset 6.74 arcsec at 7.60 bootstrap sigma; rejected event supplies no alias preference.

checks.name: TOI-7610 E1 localization
checks.note: S99 local-peak offset 2.92 arcsec at 5.71 bootstrap sigma; target origin remains unestablished.

checks.name: Independent sky epoch or instrument
checks.note: All 12 products are previously cached TESS observations.

checks.name: PRF registration uncertainty
checks.note: TOI-3500 sensitivity grid varied common registration by ±0.1 pixel and FWHM 0.8–2.0 pixels, but used a Gaussian rather than the calibrated TESS PRF.

checks.name: TOI-3500 neighbor two-source fit
checks.note: Target favored in 71% of S64 and 86% of S90 grid trials, but preference changes sign and residualized source-template correlations span 0.934–0.986 for a 0.183–0.185-pixel separation.

checks.name: TOI-7610 exact-source Gaia DR3 NSS audit
checks.note: Gaia DR3 returns an SB1 orbit with P 90.4224 d, e 0.309, K1 12.14 km/s and 23 accepted RVs; f(M)=0.0144 solar masses and conditional minimum companion mass about 0.238 solar masses. Original target-planet reading rejected.

checks.name: New RV for active leads
checks.note: No new or archival multi-epoch RV time series was analyzed for TOI-224, TOI-2666 or TOI-3500.

checks.name: Search-wide false-alarm calibration and injection recovery
checks.note: Local bootstrap localization does not calibrate search-wide significance.
